name: Pancakes
steps: Whisk the eggs and milk and sugar together.;Stir in the flour until the batter is smooth.;Melt some butter in a pan over medium heat.;Pour in a small amount of batter and fry until golden on both sides.

name: Scrambled eggs
steps: Whisk the eggs with the milk and salt.;Melt the butter in a pan over low heat.;Add the eggs and stir gently until just set.

name: Cheese omelette
steps: Chop the onion and fry it in the butter until soft.;Whisk the eggs with the salt and pour them into the pan.;When the eggs are almost set add the cheese.;Fold the omelette in half and serve.

name: Grilled cheese sandwich
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread.;Put the cheese between the slices with the buttered sides outward.;Fry in a pan until golden on both sides and the cheese has melted.

name: Tomato pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water according to the packet.;Chop the onion and garlic and tomatoes.;Fry the onion and garlic in the olive oil until soft.;Add the tomatoes and cook for 10 minutes.;Mix the sauce with the drained pasta.

name: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Chop the onion and garlic and tomatoes.;Fry the onion and garlic in the olive oil until soft.;Add the minced beef and cook until browned.;Add the tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes.;Cook the pasta and serve it with the sauce.

name: Vegetable fried rice
steps: Cook the rice and let it cool.;Chop the carrot and onion into small pieces.;Fry the vegetables in the oil for 5 minutes.;Push them aside and scramble the eggs in the pan then mix everything.;Add the rice and soy sauce and fry for another 5 minutes.

name: Chicken curry
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.;Chop the onion and garlic and fry them until soft.;Cut the chicken into pieces and fry it until no longer pink.;Stir in the curry powder and then add the coconut milk.;Simmer for 20 minutes and serve with the rice.

name: Banana smoothie
steps: Peel the bananas and break them into pieces.;Put everything in a blender and blend until smooth.

name: Greek salad
steps: Chop the tomatoes and cucumber and onion.;Put them in a bowl and crumble the feta on top.;Drizzle with olive oil and mix gently.

name: Mashed potatoes
steps: Peel and cut the potatoes then boil them for 20 minutes until soft.;Drain the potatoes and mash them.;Stir in the butter and milk and salt.

name: Potato soup
steps: Peel and chop the potatoes and onion and carrots.;Fry the onion in the butter until soft.;Add the potatoes and carrots and stock and simmer for 25 minutes.;Blend the soup until smooth and season with salt.

name: Chocolate chip cookies
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.;Mix the soft butter and sugar then beat in the egg.;Stir in the flour and then the chopped chocolate.;Put small balls of dough on a baking tray.;Bake for 12 minutes until golden at the edges.

name: Mushroom risotto
steps: Chop the onion and slice the mushrooms.;Fry the onion and mushrooms in the butter until soft.;Add the rice and stir for 2 minutes.;Add the stock a little at a time and stir until each part is absorbed.;After about 20 minutes stir in the cheese and serve.

name: Lasagna
steps: Fry the chopped onion and minced beef then add the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes.;For the white sauce melt the butter and stir in the flour then slowly whisk in the milk.;In a baking dish layer meat sauce and lasagna sheets and white sauce and repeat.;Top with the cheese.;Bake at 180 degrees for 40 minutes.

name: French toast
steps: Whisk the eggs and milk and sugar in a shallow bowl.;Soak each slice of bread in the mixture for a few seconds.;Fry the bread in the butter until golden on both sides.

name: Mac and cheese
steps: Cook the pasta according to the packet.;Melt the butter in a pan and stir in the flour.;Slowly whisk in the milk until the sauce thickens.;Stir in the cheese until melted.;Mix the sauce with the drained pasta.

name: Chicken stir-fry
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.;Cut the chicken into strips and slice the vegetables.;Fry the chicken in the oil until cooked through.;Add the vegetables and garlic and fry for 5 minutes.;Stir in the soy sauce and serve with the rice.

name: Tomato soup
steps: Chop the tomatoes and onion and garlic.;Fry the onion and garlic in the olive oil until soft.;Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer for 20 minutes.;Blend until smooth and season with salt.

name: Garlic bread
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees.;Crush the garlic and mix it with the soft butter.;Spread the garlic butter on the bread.;Bake for 8 minutes until crispy.

name: Fruit salad
steps: Peel and chop all the fruit into bite-sized pieces.;Put the fruit in a bowl and drizzle with honey and mix gently.

name: Apple crumble
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.;Peel and slice the apples and put them in a baking dish.;Rub the flour and butter and sugar together until it looks like crumbs.;Spread the crumble over the apples.;Bake for 35 minutes until golden.

name: Overnight oats
steps: Mix the oats and milk and yogurt and honey in a jar.;Leave in the fridge overnight.;Slice the banana on top before eating.

name: Homemade pizza
steps: Mix the flour and yeast and salt and olive oil with 200 ml of warm water into a dough.;Knead for 10 minutes then let it rise for 1 hour.;Preheat the oven to 220 degrees.;Roll out the dough and spread chopped tomatoes on top.;Add the cheese and bake for 15 minutes.

name: Cheeseburger
steps: Season the minced beef with salt and shape it into two burgers.;Fry the burgers for 4 minutes on each side.;Put a slice of cheese on each burger to melt.;Slice the tomato and onion.;Put everything in the buns.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Chop the onion and garlic and tomatoes.;Fry the onion and garlic in the olive oil until soft.;Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 10 minutes.;Make four small holes in the sauce and crack an egg into each.;Cover and cook until the eggs are set.

name: Chicken and potato traybake
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees.;Cut the potatoes and carrots and onion into chunks.;Put the vegetables and chicken on a baking tray.;Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.;Bake for 45 minutes and turn everything halfway.

name: Banana bread
steps: Preheat the oven to 175 degrees.;Mash the bananas and mix in the melted butter and sugar.;Beat in the eggs and then stir in the flour.;Pour into a loaf tin and bake for 55 minutes.

name: Chocolate brownies
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.;Melt the chocolate and butter together.;Whisk the eggs and sugar then stir in the chocolate mixture.;Fold in the flour and pour into a baking tin.;Bake for 25 minutes.

name: Cheese quesadilla
steps: Chop the onion and tomato.;Put cheese and onion and tomato on one tortilla and cover it with the other.;Fry in a dry pan until golden on both sides and the cheese has melted.
